item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Looking For Two Radio Edits for Two Dance-Pop Songs
item.description:
Hello everyone,

I'm looking for two hard-to-find radio edits for two songs: "One More Time" by Daft Punk and "Evacuate The Dancefloor" by Cascada:

I'm looking for the U.S. Radio Edit of "One More Time" by Daft Punk. It's shorter than the "Short Radio Edit" found on their greatest hits CD: https://www.discogs.com/release/1083917-Daft-Punk-One-More-Time

I'm also looking for the No Rap Edit of Cascada's 2009 song "Evacuate The Dancefloor". The Main Single Version has a really odd rap verse. The shorter No Rap Edit clocks in at around 3:10: https://www.discogs.com/release/3848273-Cascada-Evacuate-The-Dancefloor

Thank you!
